name: QuakeCon
blurb: Bethesda's long-running free LAN party and esports weekend at the Gaylord Texan Resort in Grapevine, Texas.
notes: QuakeCon 2026 (the 30th-anniversary BYOC, Aug 6-9) already happened before this research window and the site still headlines it as the current event, with no 2027 dates or venue announced anywhere on the page.
